reasons.plausibility: Promoting Cu-rich precipitates to enhance dislocation blocking and wear resistance aligns well with known precipitation-strengthening mechanisms, making the hypothesis scientifically sound with only minor uncertainties about precipitate stability.
reasons.testability: Measuring wear rates and microstructural evolution in annealed versus non-annealed coatings provides a straightforward and conclusive way to confirm or refute the predicted improvements.
reasons.usefulness: Linking targeted nanoprecipitate formation to enhanced high-temperature wear properties directly supports the design and development of more robust HEA coatings, making this hypothesis valuable for further research.
